payload.instruction: Make this look like a comic book photo
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Make this look like a comic book photo
requirements.source_phrase: Make this look like a comic book photo

outcomes.description: Transform the image so it has a comic-book visual style while retaining its photographic subject matter.
outcomes.target: The image visibly combines comic-book styling with a photographic appearance.
outcomes.reference: The supplied image, as edited; assess the overall visual treatment for comic-book styling and photographic subject matter.

response.content: {"decisions":[{"requirement_id":"R1","question":"Does the image visibly combine comic-book styling with a photographic appearance?","criteria":"Pass if the image has a recognizable comic-book visual style while retaining photographic subject matter; fail if neither requested quality is visibly present; unknown if the image evidence is insufficient to judge.","binding":"Compare the edited image with the supplied image, assessing its overall visual treatment for comic-book styling and photographic subject matter."}]}

decisions.question: Does the image visibly combine comic-book styling with a photographic appearance?
decisions.criteria: Pass if the image has a recognizable comic-book visual style while retaining photographic subject matter; fail if neither requested quality is visibly present; unknown if the image evidence is insufficient to judge.
decisions.binding: Compare the edited image with the supplied image, assessing its overall visual treatment for comic-book styling and photographic subject matter.
